details:
SPACE LEGACY – The Legacy We Left Behind

SPACE LEGACY is an interactive digital museum that explores human-made artifacts left behind on the Moon and Mars during historic space missions. It transforms space exploration history into an engaging digital experience where users can discover artifacts, explore planetary locations, and learn about the missions behind them.

The platform includes an Artifact Explorer featuring historical objects such as lunar module descent stages and Mars rovers, a 3D Planet Explorer that allows users to interact with visual representations of the Moon and Mars, Space Stories that explain the history and significance of missions, a Mission Timeline highlighting important exploration milestones, and a Knowledge Quiz to encourage interactive learning.

The project aims to make space heritage more accessible, improve awareness of humanity's exploration beyond Earth, and inspire curiosity about planetary science and future missions. By digitally preserving the stories of these artifacts, SPACE LEGACY helps users understand that space missions leave behind more than scientific discoveries—they leave a lasting human legacy.

We developed the project using React.js, JavaScript, Vite, Three.js, HTML5, CSS3, and Lucide React. Three.js powers the interactive 3D planetary experience, while React provides a responsive and component-based interface. The application is deployed on Vercel, with its source code maintained on GitHub.

The creative approach combines the concept of a digital museum with interactive planetary exploration. We considered accessibility, ease of navigation, visual engagement, educational value, and the accuracy of historical information while designing the experience.

SPACE LEGACY ultimately turns forgotten objects on distant worlds into stories that everyone can explore, discover, and remember.
